mapper.insert: INSERT INTO editor_image (user_id, file_path, original_name, file_size) VALUES (#{userId}, #{filePath}, #{originalName}, #{fileSize})
mapper.select: SELECT e.editor_image_id, e.user_id, e.file_path FROM editor_image e WHERE e.created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM figure_editor_image_map m WHERE m.editor_image_id = e.editor_image_id) ORDER BY e.editor_image_id
